newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields remain higher, crown softens.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields remain higher, crown softens.

text.p: Swedish debt yields were largely unchanged during light trade on Monday morning while the crown softened a little against the mark but remained firmer than last week.
By midday six-month T-bill rates were one basis point higher at 4.75 percent while nine-year bond yields remained two basis points higher at 7.64 percent.
Dealers were said the weekend's European finance meeting in Dublin had added a positive tone to the market but the market was now focusing on the Fed meeting on Tuesday.
"Trade is really light," said one dealer.
